_description: Parameter file connecting ROBIN's original source variables to ffsvca_bridge.py. Edit the values below to match your local setup before running ffsvca_bridge.py.

robin_source_mapping._note: These keys map 1-to-1 to ROBIN's inject_wm_inner_latent_robin.py argparse arguments and optim_utils.py globals.

robin_root.description: Absolute path to the unmodified robin_official/ directory

model_id.description: HuggingFace model ID for the SD pipeline

wm_path.description: Path to the ROBIN watermark checkpoint (.pt). Use optimized_r5_15_step10.pt (adversarial optimization applied, r5-15 ring). Must match w_low_radius and w_up_radius.

w_channel.description: Latent channel index where the ring watermark is embedded

w_pattern.description: Watermark pattern type. Use 'ring' for ROBIN ring-pattern

w_mask_shape.description: Shape of the frequency-domain watermark mask

w_up_radius.description: Outer radius of the ring watermark in Fourier space. MUST match checkpoint: optimized_r5_15_step10.pt uses r5-15, so w_up_radius=15.

w_low_radius.description: Inner radius of the ring watermark in Fourier space. MUST match checkpoint: r5-15 -> w_low_radius=5.

verification_config._note: Fixed-FPR Security Verification Protocol parameters (PAPER3 specific).

global_seed.description: Generation seed for clean and watermarked image generation. Fixed for reproducibility (option A). Reported as 'seed 0' in the paper.

split_seed.description: Seed for calibration/test split. Independent from global_seed for statistical decoupling.

alpha_fpr_primary.description: Primary target FPR alpha. Security requirement — NOT chosen after seeing results.

alpha_fpr_secondary.description: Secondary alpha values for Appendix analysis.

cal_ratio.description: Fraction of clean none-attack images used for calibration. 1000 * 0.5 = 500 calibration-clean samples.

n_bootstrap.description: Number of bootstrap resamples for 95% CI estimation.

e4_calibration_sizes.description: Calibration sample sizes swept in E4. Upper bound is 500 (= cal_ratio * 1000).

attack_severity._note: Main severity values fixed before experiments. Do NOT adjust after seeing results.

jpeg_quality.description: JPEG compression quality. 50 is moderate — sufficient to induce score shift. q75 is too mild.

crop_ratio.description: Crop ratio (keep fraction). 0.80 means 20% crop, then resize back to original.

attack_manifest._note: 11 attack tasks: 6 ID-single + 3 ID-composite + 2 OOD-composite. Defined per task.md authority.
